name: Gyms & personal training (category guide)
summary: Chain signup vs PT package hard-sell — complimentary session scripts, cooling-off realities, and verifying cold calls that know your name.
body: Large gym chains often bundle a complimentary PT session after signup; outbound calls that know your name are common — verify the outlet and staff ID before sharing payment details, especially on personal numbers without WhatsApp business profiles. Multi-month PT packages are the classic hard-sell: ask for per-session cash rates, freeze/transfer rules, and what happens if your trainer leaves. Consumer threads warn about mandarin-only outreach and pressure to upgrade on day one — CASE and cooling-off rules may help for some doorstep/telemarketing sales, but gym floor signups are often treated as ordinary contracts, so read before you thumbprint. Boutique studios and hotel gyms price differently; compare access hours against your condo gym before locking 12 months. Pair with the sports/fitness guide for community sport alternatives. This is a category guide for shopping honestly, not a ranked gym list.
